mapper.sql: sub_no, inst_code, regnoold, project_no, applicant_user_id, title, status, submitted_at, updated_at, deleted, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sub_mastinfo WHERE inst_code = #{instCode} AND regnoold = #{regnoold}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sub_review WHERE inst_code = #{instCode} AND legacy_review_id = #{legacyReviewId})

SELECT m.sub_no, m.inst_code, m.regnoold, m.title, m.status, m.project_no, u.user_name AS applicant_name, m.source, m.deleted, m.updated_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM sub_review r WHERE r.sub_no = m.sub_no) AS review_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM attachment a WHERE a.sub_no = m.sub_no) AS attachment_count FROM sub_mastinfo m LEFT JOIN iuser u ON u.user_id = m.applicant_user_id
AND m.inst_code = #{instCode} AND m.status = #{status} AND (lower(m.title) LIKE #{keyword} OR m.regnoold LIKE #{keyword} OR CAST(m.sub_no AS TEXT) LIKE #{keyword})
ORDER BY m.sub_no

SELECT m.sub_no, m.inst_code, m.regnoold, m.title, m.status, m.project_no, p.title AS project_title, coalesce(p.is_virtual, false) AS virtual_project, m.applicant_user_id, u.user_name AS applicant_name, m.submitted_at, m.updated_at, m.source, m.migration_run_id, m.deleted, m.version FROM sub_mastinfo m LEFT JOIN project p ON p.project_no = m.project_no LEFT JOIN iuser u ON u.user_id = m.applicant_user_id WHERE m.sub_no = #{subNo}

SELECT r.review_no, r.legacy_review_id, r.reviewer_user_id, u.user_name AS reviewer_name, r.result, r.opinion, r.reviewed_at, r.source FROM sub_review r LEFT JOIN iuser u ON u.user_id = r.reviewer_user_id WHERE r.sub_no = #{subNo} ORDER BY r.reviewed_at NULLS LAST, r.review_no
